title: Check: Effect of Concentration on Rate (2)

questions.stem: If doubling the concentration of acid approximately doubles the rate of reaction, what is the relationship between rate and concentration?

options.text: Rate is inversely proportional to concentration
Rate is directly proportional to concentration
Rate is proportional to the square of the concentration

questions.explanation: If doubling the concentration doubles the rate, the rate is directly proportional to the concentration (Rate is proportional to [reactant]). A graph of rate against concentration would give a straight line through the origin for this relationship.
